audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH SEVEN - the D&DG walk round twenty-seven, print p. 142: the seventh batch of deity rows - the twenty-four Nonhumans' Deities rows (the twenty R864 mythos beings plus Demogorgon, Surtur, Thrym and Yeenoghu) - riding the roster data file; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline geometry: every row reads the N-H-only flag (all 24 X marks at the N-H column, no M or F mark in the batch).

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch seven - the D&DG walk round twenty-seven, print p. 142: the 24 rows of the Nonhumans' Deities across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf page 142; the second printing); the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows (the Demogorgon and Yeenoghu MM pages carry no chart row - those two rows ride the print alone). The adjudications: the whole batch reads the N-H-only flag (the geometry seats all 24 X marks at the N-H column, no M or F mark anywhere; the L&L voice agrees on all 22 covered rows); the Sekolah, Semuanya, Skoraeus Stonebones, Surtur, Thrym and Yeenoghu name garbles restored per the R864 crossref pins (the stray 4 glyph before Surtur noted); the Deep Sashelas seqa green garble restored to sea green (the R872 Poseidon class); the Grolantor daork brown and na garbles restored; the Garl warhelm and Gruumsh waorhelm folds restored to war helm; the Gruumsh body wrap black plate mail with its underscore and dash-pair strays noted; the Lolth stray i glyph and wrap-line dot noted; the Yondalla colon glyph noted (both voices carry it); the Demogorgon color reptile green and the ixitxachitl sphere restore ride the print. The batch order runs the alphabetical Nonhumans walk (Blibdoolpoolp through Yondalla).

rows. Primary ink: the rotated tesseract pass; the collation
